info.title: Ember Secretless Wallet API
info.description: Secretless wallet-session, offer, quote, payment, coverage, decision, evidence, and claim APIs.

get.summary:
Discover current coverage using the authenticated wallet authority, never
local payment references. Multiple eligible records are an integrity error.

200.description: Current coverage, or an explicit none status

get.summary: Read one immutable quote-bound coverage instance.

404.description: Coverage is not visible to this wallet

200.description: Decision completed or exact retry replayed

403.description: Wallet scope, coverage, or evaluation allowance rejected the request

404.description: Coverage is not visible to this wallet

409.description: Wallet, cluster, or duplicate lineage conflicts

503.description: Decision issuance is paused or not configured

get.summary: Read the authoritative decision and current evidence state.

404.description: Decision is not visible to this wallet

get.summary: Return the immutable quote-to-decision evidence lineage.

404.description: Decision is not visible to this wallet

post.summary:
Attach exact wallet-signed evidence and transactionally enqueue finalized
transaction confirmation.

404.description: Decision is not visible to this wallet

409.description: Signed evidence conflicts with the reviewed payload

post.summary:
Submit a transaction signature for exact finalized payment verification.
The wallet supplies no price, mint, destination, cluster, payer, or term.

200.description: Payment reached a terminal activated or rejected state

202.description: Payment awaits finality, provider recovery, or provider agreement

404.description: Quote is not visible to this wallet

409.description: Quote is not payable or was already consumed

503.description: Mainnet activation is paused or not configured

get.summary: Read the authoritative state of one payment submission.

404.description: Payment is not visible to this wallet

get.summary: List public verification keys and their current lifecycle state.

503.description: Signing key registry could not be read

post.summary:
Issue a server-authored, immutable, expiring quote for the exact
authenticated wallet and offer. The request body contains no economic or
payment overrides. A live quote atomically reserves its current-period
benefit capacity, preventing payable quotes from oversubscribing the
approved production reserve.

403.description: Wallet scope or offer availability is not permitted

409.description: Terms, offer, key, or payment facts conflict

503.description: Quote issuance is disabled or not configured

get.summary:
Serve the secretless wallet contract without exposing partner credentials,
operator routes, legacy wallet compatibility routes, or operations.

post.summary: Consume a signed challenge and issue a proof-of-possession wallet session.

400.description: Challenge is invalid, expired, or already used

403.description: Wallet or integration cannot create a session

post.summary: Request a server-issued, one-use wallet proof challenge.

403.description: Integration, scope, or client binding is not permitted

post.summary: Revoke every session for this wallet and integration.

200.description: All wallet sessions for the integration revoked

post.summary:
Rotate a live session using its one-use refresh credential and current
proof-of-possession key. The old access session is revoked atomically.

401.description: Session or refresh credential is invalid

get.summary: List claims owned by the authenticated wallet subject.

post.summary: Submit a durable claim bound to the exact paid coverage and sealed decision.

403.description: Wallet scope or decision is ineligible

503.description: Claim intake is disabled or unavailable

get.summary: Read one wallet-owned claim and its immutable timeline.

post.summary: Submit an appeal against the immutable rejection decision.

409.description: Appeal is late or not allowed

post.summary: Create a short-lived upload grant for one policy-requested evidence item.

403.description: Claim or evidence request is unavailable

404.description: Claim evidence request was not found

503.description: Evidence storage or scanner is not configured

post.summary: Complete an upload after independently checking stored size and digest.

409.description: Evidence metadata conflicts or was rejected

get.summary: Read claim eligibility for one wallet-owned P09 decision.

200.description: Claim eligibility derived from sealed evidence

403.description: Wallet scope or decision is ineligible

get.summary:
List offers available to the integration bound into the authenticated
wallet session. This dedicated wallet path avoids combining partner Bearer
authentication with proof-of-possession authentication on one route.

200.description: Offers available to the wallet session integration

403.description: Wallet scope, partner, or integration is not permitted

503.description: Offer catalogue could not be resolved

get.summary:
Read one offer through the exact tenant and environment bound into the
authenticated wallet session.

200.description: Offer available to the wallet session integration

403.description: Wallet scope, partner, or integration is not permitted

404.description: Offer is unknown or unavailable to this integration

503.description: Offer catalogue could not be resolved

post.summary:
Persist explicit acceptance of the exact immutable terms document shown to
the verified wallet. Caller values are assertions checked against P04.

400.description: Offer or terms assertion is malformed

403.description: Offer is unavailable or scope is insufficient

409.description: Offer/terms assertion is stale or mismatched

ApiErrorResponse.description: Stable JSON error envelope returned by every documented API operation.

cancelled.description: True only when cancellation won, including an idempotent cancellation retry.

oneOf.description: Independent signing policy. Optional for compatibility with older servers.

dappUrl.description: HTTP or HTTPS dapp origin or page URL.

transactionBytes.description: Base64-encoded serialized Solana transaction before signing.

dappUrl.description: HTTP or HTTPS dapp origin or page URL.

messageBytes.description: Base64-encoded message bytes presented before wallet signing.

genesisHash.description: Canonical base58 32-byte Solana cluster genesis hash.

payload.description:
Canonical object signed with the P06 domain separator. Clients verify
these exact server-authored fields without adding local facts.

SimulationEffectsResponse.description:
Wallet-scoped observed balances. Amounts are decimal integer strings; SOL
changes are net changes including the network fee and account funding.

signedBytes.description: Base64-encoded serialized Solana transaction after signing.

signedMessage.description: Base64-encoded message bytes captured after wallet signing.

walletProofOfPossession.name: x-ember-wallet-session
walletProofOfPossession.description: Short-lived wallet session id. Each request also carries x-ember-wallet-timestamp, x-ember-wallet-jti, and x-ember-wallet-signature. HTTPS browser sessions must repeat their exact approved Origin; Chrome extension sessions are bound during bootstrap and may omit Origin only on signed GET requests where Chrome does not emit it. Native sessions repeat x-ember-application-id.
